entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold for ten minutes. I want to return a piece of junk you sold me.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Mike Peterson, order number is... V-F-7-7-2-9-1. And don't give me the runaround. These cycling shoes are the worst I have ever owned. I want a refund, now.

Okay, thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloPro cycling shoes purchased about two months ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Are you serious? It's an issue of them being torture devices! I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but it doesn't matter. I get horrible blisters every single time I ride more than five miles. They're garbage and I'm not paying for them.
I understand how frustrating it is when gear causes discomfort like blisters. That can definitely ruin a ride.

Frustrating? It's unacceptable! I paid good money for these. Either you process my refund right now or I'm putting you on blast on every cycling forum and social media platform I can find. And get me your manager!
Sir, there's no need for that. Please allow me just a moment to check our return policy for your item. I want to find the best solution for you.
You've got sixty seconds before I hang up and my next call is to the Better Business Bureau.

Okay Mike, I've just reviewed the policy. It looks like your purchase was made 53 days ago, and our standard items, like these cycling shoes, have a 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. Well... okay then. So you're giving me the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Right. Okay. That's... that's good. Sorry for getting heated, it's just been a real pain dealing with these blisters. The shoes just didn't work out.
I completely understand. No problem at all. Your return authorization number is RMA-94512. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mike?
No, that's it. Just the return. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
